description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/ppm_D_periodic (Piecewise Parabolic Method, Colella-Woodward 1984, semi-discrete method-of-lines flux) driven by problems/advection_1d_ppm_periodic.esm, loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Exact solution sin(2 pi (x - c t)). HONEST ORDER: PPM is nominally 3rd order (parabolic reconstruction) and the UNLIMITED flux-difference is exactly the 4th-order central first derivative, but the original 1984 monotonicity limiter still clips the two smooth extrema of the sine (the classic smooth-extremum clipping of the CW84 limiter, cured only by later extremum-preserving variants), flattening the parabola there to first order. The global error is therefore dominated by two isolated first-order points, giving a sub-nominal, norm-dependent observed order -- the Julia golden gives median observed order 1.68 in L2 (pairwise 1.93, 1.66, 1.68) and 1.35 in Linf (pairwise 1.53, 1.35, 1.18). expected_order 1.5 with order_tolerance 0.25 brackets BOTH norm medians honestly (deviation 0.18 in L2, 0.15 in Linf); this is NOT a claim of 3rd-order convergence (which the CW84 limiter forecloses on any smooth periodic profile, whose extrema always trigger the clip). Conservation is exact and is gated separately by the problem's mean assertion. MONOTONICITY UPGRADE (2026-07-13) -- ORDER RESET: stencils/ppm_flux now builds its edges on the CW84 eq. (1.8) MONOTONIZED slopes (ppm_face_value_mono) instead of the raw eq. (1.7) slopes. The previous eq.(1.10)-only chain was NOT bounded: verified IN-PIPELINE on rules/ppm_D_periodic with sharp non-negative ICs (square / spike / sawtooth, N=32/64/128), it drove the tracer to -5.3e-2 and overshot to 1.053, while the upgraded chain holds it EXACTLY in [0, 1] (min 0.0, max 1.0) on every profile and resolution. Both limiters are load-bearing -- eq. (1.8) bounds the interpolated edge, eq. (1.10)'s extremum-flattening branch stops outflux from a local minimum -- and neither alone suffices. The observed order therefore changes, and this manifest's expected_order is reset from the new Julia golden. NEW ORDER (upgraded): L2 median 1.87 (pairwise 1.74, 1.87, 1.91), Linf median 1.48 (1.25, 1.48, 1.57) -- both IMPROVED over the old eq.(1.10)-only chain (which measured ~1.5 / ~1.3), because eq.(1.10) alone clips more erratically than the full monotone reconstruction. expected_order 1.68 +/- 0.30 brackets both medians (deviation 0.19 in L2, 0.20 in Linf). The pairwise orders are not monotone; that is limiter-activation noise, not a bad golden -- the set of cells where the CW84 clip fires shifts with resolution, so a smooth-MMS order estimate for a LIMITED scheme is intrinsically ragged. The gate brackets both norm medians with enough tolerance to absorb it.
